desc: Annual Report of Aimco Pesticides Limited for Financial Year 2025-26
Notice of the 39th Annual General Meeting to be held on Friday, September 25, 2026 at 12:00 P.M IST via VC/OAVM.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we are hereby enclosing the Newspaper Publications for the 39th Annual General Meeting of the Company for Financial Year 2025-26.
Letter sent to shareholders providing web-link including exact path where the complete details of the Annual Report 2025-26 are available to these members who have not registered their Email ids.
